title: Forged with Foundry Agent Governance Contract
description: Envelope schema for a fwf-governance-contract instance (file name: governance.yaml, discovered at .fwf/agents/<agent-id>/governance.yaml). This is a Forged with Foundry community pattern, not a Microsoft Foundry or Agent Framework specification; Microsoft tooling does not discover or enforce it. See docs/governance-contract.md.

metadata.description: Identity and provenance of this contract instance. agentId must equal the '<agent-id>' directory segment the contract was discovered under (.fwf/agents/<agent-id>/governance.yaml) -- enforced by the validator, not by this schema alone.

agentId.description: Kebab-case agent identifier; must equal the .fwf/agents/<agent-id>/ directory name.

source.description: URL of the workload repository this contract belongs to.

agentRef.description: Reference to this agent's real runtime/deployment definition, if any (for example a Microsoft Foundry hosted-agent agent.yaml). This contract complements that file; it never replaces or re-validates it.

controls.description: One entry per FwF governance control this agent declares evidence for. A workload only lists the controls that actually apply to it.
